statement: BNEF estimates data-center revenue losses from the Texas pause could reach $8 billion by Q1 2027, assuming 60% of the delayed capacity is AI-related, against an earning rate of about $1.76 billion per gigawatt per month.
why: Putting a dollar figure on the delay shows how much AI compute revenue is at stake if the freeze holds.

impact.mechanism: Lost compute revenue reduces operator cash flow available to fund further accelerator purchases and slows the deployment schedule.

evidence.excerpt: Data center revenue losses could reach $8 billion by the first quarter of 2027 assuming 60% of the delayed capacity is AI-related
AI computing capacity can earn around $1.76 billion per gigawatt per month

confidence.basis: Third-party analyst estimate carried by one secondary outlet, resting on a stated assumption about AI share.
